# Kautusang Bayan No. 02, Series of 1999

**Additional Appropriations Ordinance**

## Summary

This ordinance approves and allocates Two Hundred Thousand Pesos (P 200,000.00) for additional primary needs and other expenses of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]]. It is sourced from the unappropriated balance of the Annual Budget 1999 and additional IRA for the year 1999.

## Key Provisions

1.  **Section 1.** Allocates P 200,000.00 from the unappropriated balance of the [[1999]] Annual Budget and additional IRA for the year [[1999]] for primary needs and expenses of the local government of [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
2.  **Section 2.** The additional budget No. 02, Series of [[1999]], prepared by the Honorable Mayor, is included and made an additional part of this ordinance, marked as "Annex A".
3.  **Section 3.** The ordinance on additional appropriations shall take effect upon its approval.
4.  **Section 4.** Approved this 15th day of November, [[1999]] in [[Pitogo, Quezon]].
